_comment: Round 64, features 1 and 4: answers of the board summary and response-time routes, and the round 64 target records, built by the orchestrator's own types and counting code (internal/feedcount over testdata/feedcount_vector.json; internal/artifacts PeriodSummary, SignOffTargetPassed, RunSealed and ReceiptContext). The SDKs fetch and return these documents as sent and never recount them: recounting stays in verdifax-verify. create_answer is POST /account/summaries sealing one (HTTP 201); reused_answer the same summary already sealed for that period over that feed (HTTP 200); list_answer GET /account/summaries; summary GET /account/summaries/{id}; summary_head GET /account/summaries/{id}/head, the feed-head statement the summary counted up to (internal/artifacts FeedHead), also carried as head in create_answer and reused_answer; response_times GET /account/signoffs/response-times with target=900; target_passed the entry of a signoff.target_passed event; run_sealed a run.sealed entry with setup_hash and signoff_target; receipt_context one with response_target. Every SDK reads this file in a test.

target_passed.statement: no sign-off of the kind this target compares was on the public log by the deadline
